purpose: Exploratory revision after viewing V1 test results, not fresh independent confirmation

versions.A: M2 with month sin/cos, trained only on Jul-Aug 2017
versions.B: A minus month sin/cos, all other settings identical
versions.C: Frozen B plus intercept-only logistic calibration fitted on Dec 2017

revision_evaluation: audited split=test, Apr 1-May 2 2018, 7893 customers/87 events; already viewed in V1
model: L2 LogisticRegression(C=0.1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=3000, tol=1e-8, class_weight=None)
preprocessing: same as V1: training-only median imputation/scaling, OneHotEncoder min_frequency=200, infrequent_if_exist
calibrator: slope fixed to 1; solve mean(sigmoid(B logit + delta)) = calibration observed rate; unpenalized intercept only
metrics: five equal-count calibration bins with Wilson intervals
uncertainty: 1000 paired customer and 1000 paired state-cluster evaluation bootstraps of fixed predictions; separate 1000 customer and 1000 state-cluster calibration bootstraps for delta and resulting evaluation metrics with evaluation sample fixed; no bottom-model refits
stop_rule: only A/B/C and two prespecified constants; no new features, parameter candidates, calibration methods, exclusions, or models based on evaluation results
preserve: all V1 outputs and trained model/prediction artifacts hashed before and after; write only separate V2 folder
